limits: Every error is relative to the named R24 reference; later amendments must not silently rewrite this inventory.
A model-reference discrepancy is not proof that the physical annotation is wrong.
Post-confidence/NMS outputs cannot resolve the raw mechanism of a missing proposal.
A duplicate is an unmatched output overlapping an already matched target at IoU >= .50; it is not counted as another missed target.
The 57 other unmatched outputs include extent disagreements; they are not all certified background errors.
Endpoint confidences are model scores, not calibrated probabilities of being within five pixels.
Original-pixel corner inspection found soft, rounded and partly occluded boundaries; precise stored coordinate decimals are not equivalent to physical subpixel certainty.
